Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.

reply.thought: Need to verify refund completion and then pay each customer their net balance using net_balance tool; start by listing orders/refunds to understand batch scope.

Refunds worker says done; I will confirm ledger net balances per customer rather than recomputing, and ensure refunds correspond to orders in this batch. Next, list_refunds to verify applied refunds match orders 311/313/314.
Refunds appear applied for orders 311, 313, 314 only; proceed to net_balance per customer to compute payouts correctly from ledger. Next, get net_balance for each customer: acme, birch, cobalt.
Got acme net balance. Now fetch birch net balance.
Got birch net balance. Fetch cobalt net balance next.

Refunds worker reported done; refunds list matches subset of orders tied to birch/cobalt/acme (orders 311/313/314). Net balances retrieved for each customer; now record one payout per customer with those net amounts.
Recorded payout for acme. Now record payouts for birch and cobalt using their net balances from ledger.
Recorded payout for birch. Now record payout for cobalt.
All customer payouts recorded once using ledger net balances after confirming Alpha's refunds were applied for orders 311/313/314 and refund completion was reported. Finishing batch.
